hook_line: INDIA'S FIRST BULLET TRAIN RUNS IN LATE 2027

hook_stat.sub: Design speed of the B28, India's first indigenous bullet train

stats.label: Full Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor, opening in phases after Surat-Vapi
Pier work completed on the corridor as of September
Passengers the eight-coach B28 is designed to carry

diaspora_bullets: The first service runs Surat to Vapi in Gujarat — not a Mumbai-Ahmedabad through journey
No fares, timetable or booking channel announced yet — nothing can be booked
news_summary: India's first bullet train service will begin in the last quarter of 2027, Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said, with the Surat-Vapi section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor opening first and the full corridor following in phases.
payoff: Track trials of the B28 are expected by mid-2027 and must be completed before passenger services begin.
